title: Using xdrip on Unihertz Atom - Android 9
body: Installed latest nightly on Unihertz Atom (Android 9) and it aggressively stops collector (Nightscout follower) as soon it goes to standby. Even when I press power button to shut the screen off, when I come back I can see that icon on top android bar is gone, and Follower does not work until I start xdrip again. Anyone knows which setting am I looking for to fix?

comments.body: I think I found setting of the phone (Settings > smartAssistant > AppBlocker) that is on by default. Icon not disappearing now. Will close this issue tomorrow, if I can go through this night.
